# CI and local development tools: parallel test runs, coverage and lint. Install after requirements.lock:
#     python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock -r requirements-dev.txt
# Hashes: python tools/lock_hashes.py requirements-dev.txt
# This file assumes requirements.lock is installed first: pytest (pytest-xdist, pytest-cov) and typing_extensions (mypy)
# are pinned there, and --require-hashes refuses a dependency that neither file pins.
# These are NOT validator dependencies. They are deliberately kept out of requirements.txt: the validator checks every
# requirements.txt package against docs/examples/licenses.yaml (E-LIC-MISSING), and licenses.yaml is pinned by the signed
# example engagement (config_pins), so listing a tool there means re-signing every example.
